steps: Install a trusted old Debug and open Geonical; defer the offer and recreate MainActivity to see it again.

With Debug missing the export Activity, use Import from the old app in Underlay storage and expect the update offer rather than the unsupported toast; verify disabled/non-exported Activity is not accepted as an available exporter.
Verify crash recovery and a pending self-update take precedence; the offer suppresses only the automatic self-update check.
Start from Underlay storage, allow unknown-source installation, recreate the process and return through verified cached installation.
Verify focus changes while progress is dismissed do not stack permission dialogs or consume the pending installer phase; return from Android Settings directly to one Package Installer prompt.
Complete installation and verify the original transfer confirmation appears only for the same active project; startup origin only shows a message.
Cancel permission or installation; verify no transfer, no install loop and unchanged Debug data.
Reject wrong package, flavor, code, hash, signer, URL and a signed APK without exporter.
